_provenance.description: Quality-metric percentiles across 199 raw deposited PDB crystals from FRUTON-NEW/, computed 2026-08-23 by baseline_quality_check_full.py. Used as an INDEPENDENT reference distribution for the adaptive-refine policy (see _adaptive_refine_policy.py). None of the 48 AF-available bench proteins are calibrated against these numbers - the ceiling is derived from a population that is disjoint in intent (raw crystals, no gap-fill) from the bench population (crystals + AF splice + refine).
